column5: He has a lot of courage and is not afraid of difficulties.
column6: 勇气 is courage: 有勇气 (to have courage), 很大的勇气 (great courage), 失去勇气 (to lose courage).

column4: 请告诉我这个词的用法。
column5: Please tell me how to use this word.
column6: 用法 is how something is used: 词的用法 (the use of a word), 用法很简单 (easy to use).

column5: This app has many users.
column6: 用户 is a user of a product or a service: 手机用户 (a phone user), 新用户 (a new user).

column3: to use force; to exert oneself
column5: Please push this door hard.
column6: 用力 is to use strength: 用力推 (to push hard), 用力拉 (to pull hard). It is a verb-object word.

column5: This shop sells school supplies.
column6: 用品 are things for a use: 学习用品 (school supplies), 生活用品 (daily necessities), 运动用品 (sports goods).

column5: This thing has many uses.
column6: 用途 is the use or purpose of a thing: 有用途 (to have a use), 用途很多 (many uses).

column5: This shop has a discount today.
column6: 优惠 is a discount or a special price: 有优惠 (to have a discount), 优惠价 (a discount price), 很优惠 (a good deal).

column5: China has a long history.
column6: 悠久 is long-lasting, for history and culture: 历史悠久 (with a long history), 悠久的文化 (a long-standing culture).

column5: The environment here is excellent.
column6: 优良 is excellent and good: 成绩优良 (good results), 优良的传统 (a fine tradition).

column5: This song is very beautiful.
column6: 优美 is graceful and lovely, for scenery, music and movement: 优美的风景 (beautiful scenery), 动作优美 (graceful movement).

column5: His advantage is that he can speak Chinese.
column6: 优势 is an advantage over others: 有优势 (to have an advantage), 最大的优势 (the biggest advantage).

column5: This shop sells high-quality fruit.
column6: 优质 is of high quality: 优质产品 (a high-quality product), 优质服务 (high-quality service).

column4: 由此可以看出，他很努力。
column5: From this one can see that he works hard.
column6: 由此 is "from this, hence", used in writing: 由此可见 (from this it can be seen), 由此可以看出 (from this one can tell).

column4: 我想把这封信邮寄出去。
column5: I want to post this letter.
column6: 邮寄 is to send by post: 邮寄东西 (to post things), 邮寄信 (to mail a letter).

column5: The post office is next to the bank.
column6: 邮局 is a post office: 去邮局 (to go to the post office), 邮局关门 (the post office closes).

column4: 我们在上海游览了三天。
column5: We toured Shanghai for three days.
column6: 游览 is to tour places of interest: 游览风景 (to tour the scenery), 游览公园 (to tour a park).

column5: This letter needs a stamp.
column6: 邮票 is a postage stamp: 一张邮票 (a stamp), 贴邮票 (to stick on a stamp).

column5: I ate a fried dough stick for breakfast.
column6: 油条 is a long fried dough stick that is eaten for breakfast: 一根油条 (a fried dough stick), 油条和豆浆 (youtiao and soy milk).

column4: 他犹豫了一下，还是去了。
column5: He hesitated for a moment, but still went.
column6: 犹豫 is to hesitate: 很犹豫 (very hesitant), 别犹豫 (do not hesitate).

column5: Smoking is harmful to the body.
column6: 有害 is "harmful": 有害健康 (harmful to health), 对…有害 (harmful to …). The opposite is 有益.

column5: His hands are very strong.
column6: 有力 is strong and powerful: 很有力 (very strong), 有力的证明 (strong proof).

column5: This is very favourable to us.
column6: 有利 is advantageous: 对…有利 (favourable to …), 有利条件 (favourable conditions).

column5: Our time is limited.
column6: 有限 is limited: 时间有限 (limited time), 有限的钱 (limited money). The opposite is 无限.

column5: Exercise is beneficial to the body.
column6: 有益 is beneficial: 对…有益 (beneficial to …), 有益健康 (good for health).

column4: 多听多说有助于学好汉语。
column5: Listening and speaking a lot helps one learn Chinese well.
column6: 有助于 is "to help (to)": 有助于健康 (helps health), 有助于学习 (helps study).

column5: My child is in kindergarten.
column6: 幼儿园 is a kindergarten: 上幼儿园 (to go to kindergarten), 幼儿园老师 (a kindergarten teacher).

column5: There are many entertainment activities here.
column6: 娱乐 is entertainment, or to have fun: 娱乐活动 (entertainment activities), 娱乐节目 (an entertainment show).

column5: His tone of voice is very serious.
column6: 语气 is the tone in which something is said: 语气很好 (a good tone), 礼貌的语气 (a polite tone).

column5: There is a lot of rainfall this year.
column6: 雨水 is rainwater or rainfall: 雨水多 (a lot of rain), 地上的雨水 (rainwater on the ground).

column5: My Chinese teacher is very good.
column6: 语文 is the school subject of Chinese language and literature in China: 语文课 (Chinese class), 语文老师 (a Chinese teacher). 汉语 is Chinese as a foreign language.

column5: His Chinese pronunciation is very standard.
column6: 语音 is the sounds of a language: 语音练习 (pronunciation practice), 标准的语音 (standard pronunciation).

column5: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
column6: 预报 is to forecast, or a forecast, as in 天气预报 (the weather forecast).

column5: Nobody can predict the future.
column6: 预测 is to predict: 预测未来 (to predict the future), 预测结果 (to predict the result).

column5: I want to book a room.
column6: 预订 is to book in advance: 预订房间 (to book a room), 预订机票 (to book a plane ticket).

column5: Washing hands often can prevent colds.
column6: 预防 is to prevent in advance: 预防感冒 (to prevent colds), 预防生病 (to prevent illness).

column5: It is expected that it will rain tomorrow.
column6: 预计 is to expect or estimate: 预计时间 (the estimated time), 预计明天 (expected for tomorrow).

column5: I like eating corn.
column6: 玉米 is corn: 一根玉米 (an ear of corn), 吃玉米 (to eat corn).

column5: I want to make an appointment for tomorrow.
column6: 预约 is to make an appointment: 预约时间 (to book a time), 提前预约 (to book in advance).

column5: Please put the book back in its original place.
column6: 原 means "original": 原地 (the original spot), 原有 (the original, existing), 原则 (principle).

column5: The moon is very round today.
column6: 圆 is round, or a circle: 圆的 (round), 画圆 (to draw a circle).

column5: They keep the original look.
column6: 原有 is "originally had, existing before": 原有的 (the original), 原有的样子 (the original look).

column5: New Year's Day is January 1st.
column6: 元旦 is New Year's Day, 1 January: 过元旦 (to celebrate New Year's Day), 元旦快乐 (Happy New Year's Day). 春节 is the Spring Festival.

column4: 这家公司有五十名员工。
column5: This company has fifty employees.
column6: 员工 is an employee: 新员工 (a new employee), 公司员工 (company staff).

column5: A person must have principles.
column6: 原则 is a principle: 有原则 (to have principles), 原则问题 (a matter of principle).

column5: Wishing you all happiness.
column6: 愿 is to wish, or to be willing: 愿你快乐 (may you be happy), 不愿说 (not willing to say). 愿意 is the everyday "be willing".

column4: 我的愿望是去中国旅行。
column5: My wish is to travel in China.
column6: 愿望 is a wish: 一个愿望 (a wish), 实现愿望 (to make a wish come true).

column5: We agree to meet tomorrow.
column6: 约定 is to agree on something with someone, or an agreement: 约定时间 (to fix a time), 一个约定 (an agreement).

column4: 这辆车可以运很多东西。
column5: This vehicle can carry many things.
column6: 运 is to carry or transport: 运东西 (to carry things), 运到 (to transport to). It is also in 运动 and 运气.

column5: Do I need to pay shipping costs?
column6: 运费 is the cost of transport: 付运费 (to pay shipping), 免运费 (free shipping).

column5: My luck is very good today.
column6: 运气 is luck: 运气好 (lucky), 运气不好 (unlucky).

column5: These fruits are transported by train.
column6: 运输 is to transport goods: 运输东西 (to transport things), 铁路运输 (rail transport).

column4: 他很会运用学到的知识。
column5: He is very good at applying the knowledge he has learned.
column6: 运用 is to apply skill or knowledge: 运用知识 (to apply knowledge), 运用办法 (to use a method).

column5: At that time, many people were present.
column6: 在场 is to be on the spot: 在场的人 (the people present), 不在场 (not present).

column4: 他一点也不在乎别人怎么说。
column5: He does not care at all what others say.
column6: 在乎 is to care about, to mind: 不在乎 (do not care), 在乎别人 (to care about others).

column5: The price includes shipping.
column6: 在内 is "included": 包括…在内 (including …), 我也在内 (including me).

column5: Is he online now?
column6: 在线 is "online": 在线学习 (to learn online), 不在线 (not online).

column3: to lie in; to depend on
column5: The key to studying lies in persistence.
column6: 在于 is "to lie in", used in writing: 关键在于 (the key lies in), 问题在于 (the problem is that …).

column5: I agree with your idea.
column6: 赞成 is to agree with or support: 赞成这个办法 (to approve this method), 不赞成 (to disapprove).

column5: The weather today is really bad.
column6: 糟 is bad or in a mess: 很糟 (very bad), 糟了 (oh no). It is also in 糟糕.

column5: Oh no, I forgot to bring my keys!
column6: 糟糕 is terrible, or "oh no" at the start of a sentence: 糟糕！ (Oh no!), 很糟糕 (terrible).

column5: This is a book that he wrote early on.
column6: 早期 is the early period: 早期的作品 (early works), 早期发现 (early detection).

column3: morning and evening; sooner or later
column5: He goes running both morning and evening.
column6: 早晚 is "morning and evening", or "sooner or later": 早晚都 (both morning and evening), 早晚会 (sooner or later will).

column5: He has known about this for a long time.
column6: 早已 is "long ago, already", stronger than 已经: 早已知道 (knew long ago), 早已不在 (long gone).

column5: They are building a new bridge.
column6: 造 is to make or build: 造桥 (to build a bridge), 造句 (to make a sentence), 中国造 (made in China).

column5: The heavy rain caused many problems.
column6: 造成 is to bring about, usually something bad: 造成问题 (to cause problems), 造成损失 (to cause losses).

column4: 这个城市的人口增了很多。
column5: This city's population has increased a lot.
column6: 增 is to increase, and it is mostly found inside words: 增加 (to increase), 增长 (to grow), 增强 (to strengthen), 增进 (to improve).

column4: 旅行可以增进朋友之间的感情。
column5: Travelling can deepen the feelings between friends.
column6: 增进 is to improve or deepen a relationship or understanding: 增进感情 (to deepen feelings), 增进了解 (to improve understanding).

column5: Exercising a lot can strengthen the body.
column6: 增强 is to make stronger: 增强体力 (to build strength), 增强信心 (to boost confidence).

column5: He gave me a book as a gift.
column6: 赠 is to give as a gift, in a formal way: 赠书 (to give a book), 赠给 (to present to).

column3: to give as a gift; to present
column4: 买一台电脑，赠送一个包。
column5: Buy a computer, and get a free bag.
column6: 赠送 is to give something free, as a gift: 赠送礼物 (to give a gift), 免费赠送 (to give away free).

column5: Mum is deep-frying fish.
column6: 炸 is to deep-fry, read zhá: 炸鱼 (to deep-fry fish), 炸鸡 (fried chicken). Its other reading, zhà, means "to explode".

column5: The children are picking apples from the tree.
column6: 摘 is to pick fruit or flowers, or to take off: 摘苹果 (to pick apples), 摘下来 (to take off).

column5: This road is very narrow.
column6: 窄 is narrow: 很窄 (very narrow), 窄路 (a narrow road). The opposite is 宽.

column4: 博物馆里展出了很多老照片。
column5: Many old photos are exhibited in the museum.
column6: 展出 is to put on display: 展出作品 (to exhibit works), 正在展出 (on display now).

column5: He unfolded the map.
column6: 展开 is to unfold, or to start something on a large scale: 展开地图 (to unfold a map), 展开讨论 (to start a discussion).

column5: This exhibition is very interesting.
column6: 展览 is an exhibition: 看展览 (to see an exhibition), 一个展览 (an exhibition).
